environment.description: Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on port 443. The Redis broker (ElastiCache) is accessible from any source that can reach the ALB. The API endpoint at /api/v1/upload/process accepts POST requests that enqueue Celery tasks with user-controlled 'options' payload including chunk_size. No network restrictions on who can submit tasks to the broker.

config.redis_broker: ElastiCache cluster, VPC-internal but API gateway forwards task payloads
